Code blocks built for AI answers. Syntax highlighting that keeps up with streaming, copy, download and wrap, line numbers and highlighted lines, diffs with…

Code in an AI answer arrives a few characters at a time, often as a diff someone has to approve. Code Block highlights while it streams, follows new lines unless the reader has scrolled up, and keeps copy, download and wrap out of the way until the code is complete.

Pass a unified diff and you get old and new line numbers, a change count and tinted rows; copying gives the new version, not the diff.
